اعتقلنا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَقَلْنَا (iʕtaqalnā) /iʕ.ta.qal.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# اُعْتُقِلْنَا (uʕtuqilnā) /uʕ.tu.qil.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
